note: Public-sector destinations. Terapianavigaattori and Mielenterveystalo are first-class destinations, not competitors: HUS routes people inside the public system and Reitti points at that route rather than around it. PROVISIONAL until clinician sign-off. Each entry declares `role`: 'care' is the support itself, 'route' is a way of reaching it (an assessment, a referral desk, a navigator). Only 'care' may be named as the free thing available at a rung — Terapianavigaattori routes people to group therapy, it is not free group therapy.

entries.operator: HUS / Terapiat etulinjaan (tech at DigiFinland from 2026)
entries.note: Anonymous, validated symptom measures, one-month consent code, downloadable report. Makes NO automated conclusion or treatment recommendation by design — a professional decides at the ensijäsennys visit. CE-marked under MDR.
Verified 2026-09-08: free, no login and no referral required, used anonymously. Also published in Russian, Ukrainian and Sámi languages, which this entry does not yet list.

Free at the point of use but requires a doctor's referral, which is why the health-station entry sits alongside it. Role is 'gated-care', not 'route': this IS the treatment, publicly delivered and free to the patient. Calling it a route left rung 2 labelled FREE and naming nobody, which read as free care having run out above peer support. It has not; there is a referral and a queue in the way.
The ensijäsennys route. This is the door to a referral, and therefore the door to nettiterapia and to Kela's three-month treatment-contact requirement.

NOT CLINICIAN-REVIEWED. Added on the product owner's instruction (D-23). Verified 2026-09-18 on yths.fi. Eligibility, from yths.fi/en/using-services/who-can-use-our-services/: 'You can use FSHS services if you are studying for a Bachelor's or Master's degree and you have registered as present for the current semester'; postgraduate, open-university and non-degree exchange students are excluded. Cost, from yths.fi/en/using-services/service-fees/: 'We at the FSHS do not charge for other services or appointments, except a charge for an unattended appointment'; the healthcare fee is paid to Kela. The fee amount is deliberately NOT printed: it changes yearly and sources disagree on whether EUR 70.70 is per term or per year for 2026. Care model, from the mental-health page: assessment-of-need team by phone or chat, then groups, psychiatric nurse, psychologist short-term therapy, psychiatrist; only group-therapy and short-term-individual are claimed as rungs, because only those map to what the page says YTHS itself provides. Languages, from the language strategy: Finnish and Swedish in bilingual areas, and 'at least acceptable English' for others; groups run mainly in Finnish. Phone 046 710 1073 is the general and mental-health line on the front page; its hours were marked 'exceptional' on 2026-09-18, so the hours string prints only the chat hours (Mon-Thu 8-15, Fri 8-14, stated on two pages) and tells people to check the phone hours. `role: route` for consistency with `health-station`: YTHS is the door and also provides care behind an assessment, so a reviewer may prefer `gated-care` (C6).
